author: Church Machine
source:
; ============================================================
; Abstraction:  ide.Alice
; Description:  Two-enemies capability-containment example
; Language:     Church Machine ISA assembly
; ============================================================
;
; Public method selectors:
;   1  Stash(value in DR1) -> ok in DR1
;   2  Reveal()            -> secret in DR1
;
; Physical c-list:
;   [0] SELF         E   (minted when the dynamic NS slot is allocated)
;   [1] SECRET_DATA  RW  (same resident LUMP, never delegated)
;
; The private word is code word 9.  It is executable-addressable so the
; resident object's RW capability can cover it, but WORD 0 is never reached
; by either method.

capabilities {
    __SELF__ E,
    SECRET_DATA RW
}

BRANCH stash
BRANCH reveal

stash:
LOAD   CR1, CR6, 1
DWRITE DR1, CR1, #9
RETURN

reveal:
LOAD  CR1, CR6, 1
DREAD DR1, CR1, #9
RETURN

WORD 0
description: Stores and reveals one private word through an RW capability that never leaves Alice.

provenance.disposition: reissued from behavioral specification; supplied token and code were placeholders
